sum: Perpetuals.com Ltd operates as a fintech company that pairs proprietary AI with regulated market infrastructure to open global financial markets. The company offers Kronos X, a multi-asset exchange infrastructure software solution that provides fully regulated trading technology compliant with applicable EU regulations, including MiFID II, MiCA, DORA, and EMIR; and UpsideOnly.com, a retail-facing trading and market prediction platform that allows users to make simulated predictions about financial markets, including stocks, futures, foreign exchange, and cryptocurrencies. It also design, develop, and integrate software and systems based on customers specific requirements; and sale non-fungible tokens, as well as provides professional consulting and solution services. The company was formerly known as Earlyworks Co., Ltd and changed its name to Perpetuals.com Ltd in January 2026. Perpetuals.com Ltd was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
ceo: Mr. Satoshi  Kobayashi (Co-CEO, Interim CFO & Representative Director)
